correctness.rationale: Exact moment formulas reduce the derivative sign to D_k. D_2=6 and D_3=248/9. For k>=4, E_k=4(8/3)^k-9*2^k has E_4=4720/81>27 and E_{k+1}>2E_k, so D_k=E_k-27 plus positive terms is positive. Since the variance is positive, rho_n'(1/3)<0 for every n>=3.

originality.rationale: The lead source explicitly presents uniform probability-vector extremality as an expectation without proof. Searches found a sharp two-draw result and a prior three-draw counterexample, but no all-sample-size theorem. The present claim strictly extends the three-draw case and proves the exact n=2 versus n>=3 phase boundary.
